integrity: The central identity is an exact algebraic consequence of the printed vector field and is replayed by dependency-free exact polynomial arithmetic. Infinite-time statements are proved analytically from boundedness and invariant-measure identities, not inferred from finite simulation. The source equations, parameter values, multistability example, and offset transformation were checked against public primary-text material.
scientific_limitations: The long-time mean-square conclusion assumes a bounded forward trajectory. The invariant-measure identities assume compact support; zero means and the strict \(y\)-RMS inequality require \(d\ne0\), and strictness additionally requires \(b>0\). The result does not prove bounded-attractor existence or independently reproduce the source’s Lyapunov spectra. An unindexed prior statement of the same coboundary remains a residual originality risk.
title: Forcing-selected RMS rigidity across multistability and offset boosting in a no-equilibrium hyperchaotic flow
